commentary: Nobody designed that run — **the robot invented it**, in simulation

credit.name: @evolving.ai
credit.note: original broadcast footage uncredited in the source

caption:
Tiangong Omni took 400m gold at the World Humanoid Robot Games in Beijing. 45.66 seconds, 1.35 metres tall, arms clamped over its face the whole way.

The pose is the story, not the time.

No engineer designed it. The gait emerged on its own through reinforcement learning in simulation — the robot was rewarded for staying upright and fast, and this is the shape it converged on. Its developers have said outright that it was spontaneous, not specified.

That's the part worth sitting with. It looks wrong because it was never trying to look human. This is what "fast and stable" turns out to look like when nothing is copying us.

Chinese media nicknamed it the shy run.
